sentences.text:
Mithun  Ct.No.42.
 WPA 22572 of 2014  Calcutta Electric Manufacturing Co.Ltd. & Anr.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Ors.
 Mr. A.Chatterjee, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. A.K.Gayen,
 Ms. A.A. Gayen,
 ..for the petitioners.
 Mr. Satyajit Talukdar,
 Ms. Piu Karmakar  ...for K.M.D.A.
 Mr. K.N.Nabi,
 Mr. Amritlal Chatterjee,
 ...for the State respondents.
The instant writ petition relates to payment of compensation by the Special Land Acquisition Officer (Howrah Improvement Trust), Howrah in terms of his letter dated 25th July, 2019 addressed to the learned State Advocate, High Court, Calcutta in the following letter head :-
"Government of West Bengal, Office of the District Magistrate and Collector,
Howrah, Special Land Acquisition (HIT) Department District Level Building, Ground Floor, 12, Nityadhan Mukherjee Road, Howrah-711101."
It is submitted by the learned Advocate on behalf of the State that with regard to payment of compensation, he had the occasion to meet the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Howrah and the said Officer informed him that the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Howrah Improvement Trust,
Howrah is the person responsible for final decision with regard to compensation.
I have perused the copy of the letter annexed with the supplementary affidavit filed by the petitioner.

The Special Land Acquisition Officer, Howrah Improvement Trust, Howrah sought for a clarification from the L & LR Department, vide office Memo No.231/LA/IT dated 1.7.2015 for Calcutta Electric Manufacturing ... vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 12 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107134427/
1 finalization of the compensation.

entities.text: Calcutta Electric Manufacturing ... vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Special Land Acquisition Officer (Howrah Improvement Trust), Howrah is directed to appear personally in Court with the final decision of the L & LR Department which is supposed to be taken in pursuance of his letter dated 1.7.2015 for ascertainment of amount of compensation.

It is made clear that under the facts and circumstances of this case, the petitioner is entitled to compensation under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Matter be listed under the same heading on 22nd November, 2023.

The learned Registrar General, High Court, Calcutta is directed to communicate this order to the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Howrah Improvement Trust, Howrah in the above address for information and strict compliance.

(Bibek Chaudhuri, J.)
